summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: This package advertises itself as an ESLint TypeScript/React configuration but ships an obfuscated install-time dropper. package.json declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs uses hex-named identifiers, and at install time fetches the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (URL constructed as `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<name>.zip`), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [<pkg>/math_init.js])`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) obfuscated with hex/random identifier renaming and a numeric string-array decode table. An ESLint configuration package has no functional need to fetch a second language runtime at install time or to execute an opaque bundled sibling script. The combination of hex-obfuscated setup shim + install-time download of an alternate runtime + execution of a large obfuscated bundle shipped in the tarball is an alternate-runtime dropper — installing the package runs attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine, and use of Bun (rather than Node) evades Node-focused scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
